meta.title: Soleil — move the sun pavilion to Mestre
meta.description: Campaign deck from the Soleil collective to save their 2026 Biennale pavilion from demolition and rebuild it as a free reading room in a Mestre schoolyard: the waste, the plan, the cost, momentum and a 31 January pledge deadline.

slides.heading: Give the sun pavilion a second life in Mestre.
slides.notes: Say Mestre clearly. Most of the room has never been there, and that is the point.

slides.heading: On 30 January, the pavilion 42,000 people visited goes to landfill
slides.lead: Demolition is booked. The cranes arrive the next morning.
slides.imageAlt: The Soleil pavilion, a timber arch in front of a yellow sun disk, with a coral demolition tag dated 30 January and a skip filling with beams.

slides.heading: 92% of Biennale pavilions are scrapped within a month of closing

stats.label: Scrapped in 30 days, 2025 count of 86 pavilions
Timber and steel in Soleil alone

slides.heading: In Mestre it becomes a free reading room for 3,000 pupils
slides.lead: Same arch, same sun, on the Scuola Parini schoolyard.
slides.imageAlt: The same timber arch and yellow sun rebuilt in a schoolyard, with trees, children and a sign reading Biblioteca Soleil, Mestre.

slides.heading: Scrapping costs €240k today; moving costs €1.8M and lasts 30 years
slides.left:
€240k
Gone in six weeks
380 t of waste
slides.right:
€1.8M
€60k a year over 30 years
Zero waste

slides.quote: Mestre has 90,000 people and one public library. Our children cross a bridge to find culture.
slides.by: Giulia Bortolin · Head teacher, Scuola Parini, Mestre

slides.heading: Every panel is numbered, so the pavilion rebuilds in nine weeks
slides.body: We built Soleil to come apart: 148 bolted panels, no glue.

slides.heading: Three moves open the reading room in Mestre on 9 May 2027
214 people have already pledged €1.1M of the €1.8M
slides.notes: Name two supporters in the room if they agree. Social proof beats the number.

slides.heading: 31 January is the last day before the cranes arrive
Pledge now, and the sun pavilion opens in Mestre on 9 May.
slides.lead: Pledges start at €20, and every name goes on the arch.
